entities.name: Martín de Bertendona
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Don Martín de Bertendona was a Spanish Navy officer who served during the reigns of Philip II and Philip III. He participated in the Spanish Armada, and participated in the capture of the English galleon Revenge in 1591.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Don Martín de Bertendona was a Spanish Navy officer who served during the reigns of Philip II and Philip III. He participated in the Spanish Armada, and participated in the capture of the English galleon Revenge in 1591.
